title: Modifer stack
description: Describes a set of operations to apply in order: add_value -> add_base -> multiply -> final_add.

add_value.description: Adds the given value to the total. First step.

add_base.description: Adds this fraction of the base value (starting value + add_value modifiers) to the total. Second step.

multiply.description: Multiplies the total by the given value. Third step.

final_add.description: Adds the given value to the total. Final step.
